data.title: 冰堂美智留 · 学校天台夕阳下的双棒冰棍抢食
data.description: 夏日落日熔金的天台铁丝网旁，美智留无袖水手服下露出修长手臂。她毫无防备地凑上来一口咬住你手中的双棒冰棍，狡黠地眨眼咽下，微风吹乱黑色短发，洋溢着无限青梅竹马的心动。
data.location: school rooftop terrace surrounded by chain-link fence at dusk
data.action: leaning forward to take a bite from partner popsicle, winking cheekily with windblown short black hair under crimson sunset sky
data.lighting: brilliant golden hour twilight painting the rooftop in rich amber and orange
data.mood: carefree nostalgic youth, playful tomboy charm, sweet twilight romance
data.promptProse: On a windy school rooftop at sunset, short-haired Michiru Hyoudou takes a playful bite from partner popsicle, winking with her signature beauty mark in golden light.
data.animaCaption: Michiru Hyoudou biting partner popsicle playfully on sunset rooftop.
